# Yautja
Yautja have acidic blood.
They take [color=#1e90ff]20% less blunt and piercing damage[/color], [color=#1e90ff]15% less slash damage[/color], [color=#1e90ff]10% less shock damage[/color], [color=#1e90ff]20% less poison damage[/color], but [color=#ffa500]15% more heat and cold damage[/color].
